name: Sin 1
overview: The opening chapters of Genesis reveal the tragic entrance of sin into the world, marked by Adam and Eve's sudden awareness of their nakedness and shame, leading them to hide from God. When confronted by the Lord, Adam confesses his disobedience by blaming the woman God gave him, illustrating the fruit of sin as separation from God and broken fellowship. These passages highlight the devastating consequences of sin, including fear, guilt, and alienation from the Creator.
